copy.title: Rabbit Pointing toward a Green Arrow

copy.alt: Eight blue candles and a taller white candle burn in a gold Hanukkah lamp beside a night window.
copy.description: Gold coins fill a small blue bowl beside the lamp. On the opposite side, a blue vase with a gold star holds leafy branches against distant illuminated buildings.

observations: A gold nine-branched lamp holds eight blue candles and a taller central white candle.
Gold coins sit by a blue curtain opposite a star-decorated vase and a night city view.

copy.title: Red Lantern and Blossom Frame
copy.alt: Red hanging lanterns and blossoms decorate a deep red panel with fine gold trim.
copy.description: Flowering branches enter from opposing corners. Gold lines and curled cloud-like motifs finish the ornamental border.

observations: Red lanterns hang beside red blossoms on a dark red panel.
Thin gold lines and curled corner motifs frame the empty center.

copy.title: Diwali Lamps and Rangoli Frame
copy.alt: Small lit clay lamps surround a purple panel with a colorful rangoli pattern.
copy.description: The large floral floor pattern enters from the lower left. Golden flames and a narrow gold border brighten the otherwise open violet space.

observations: Small clay lamps with yellow flames sit around a purple panel.
A multicolored flower-like rangoli pattern spreads from the lower-left corner.

copy.title: Jack-o'-Lantern under a Crescent Moon
copy.alt: Glowing jack-o'-lantern rests beneath a bare tree and crescent moon in a purple night scene.
copy.description: A crooked fence runs along the lower right. Distant hills, small stars and a dark tree silhouette surround the open sky.

observations: An orange carved pumpkin glows beside a bare black tree.
A yellow crescent moon and a crooked fence sit against layered purple hills.

copy.title: Easter Egg Meadow Frame
copy.alt: Decorated pastel eggs and white daisies border a grassy meadow under blue sky.
copy.description: Tall flowering stems climb the side edges. Different egg patterns and colors gather along the bottom, leaving the middle open.

observations: Pink, blue, yellow and green patterned eggs lie among grass and white daisies.
Tall leafy stems frame a large open blue sky area.

copy.title: Gingham Picnic Cloth with Strawberries
copy.alt: Red-and-white checked picnic cloth holds a strawberry basket in the lower right.
copy.description: Loose berries and small white blossoms spill from the wicker basket. Soft folds ripple along the cloth's outer edge.

observations: A red-and-white gingham cloth forms a broad rectangular panel.
A wicker basket of strawberries and white flowers fills one lower corner.

copy.title: Bakery Counter and Pastry Shelves
copy.alt: Wooden bakery counter displays breads and pastries between tall plant-topped shelves.
copy.description: Croissants and small cakes fill the side shelves and counter. A hanging lamp shines above the open cream wall in the center.

observations: Breads, pastries and small cakes sit on a wooden counter and side shelves.
Trailing green plants and a hanging lamp frame an open cream wall.

copy.title: Sports Field and Running Track
copy.alt: Striped green playing field is surrounded by a red running track beneath blue sky.
copy.description: White lane markings curve across the foreground. Trees line the horizon below the large open patch of sky.

observations: A broad green striped field sits inside a red athletics track.
White lane lines, distant green trees and blue sky complete the landscape.

copy.title: Blue City Skyline across Water
copy.alt: Blue high-rise skyline stands behind green trees and a calm waterfront.
copy.description: Different tower heights create a stepped silhouette across the middle. Pale reflections extend into the water below the open sky.

observations: Blue towers of varied heights rise behind a line of green trees.
Still water reflects the skyline under a pale blue sky.

copy.title: Decorated Kraft Paper Panel
copy.alt: Torn kraft paper is decorated with leafy sprigs, daisies, paint strokes and patterned tape.
copy.description: Green checked tape overlaps one corner, while mustard and purple marks color the edges. The speckled paper center stays clear.

observations: A torn tan paper panel carries green checked tape and colored paint marks.
Small white flowers and leafy sprigs decorate two opposing edges.

copy.title: Black Floral Border with Open Center
copy.alt: Black-and-white flowers and leafy branches form a rectangular border.
copy.description: Large blossoms anchor the four corners, with smaller buds along the sides. Solid black leaves contrast with the fine petal outlines.

observations: Outlined flowers and solid black leaves form a rectangular frame.
Large corner blossoms surround a completely open white center.

copy.title: Black and Gold Art Deco Frame
copy.alt: Tall open frame with black and gold fan ornaments at all four corners.
copy.description: Thin gold rules connect the stepped corner fans. The narrow rectangular opening suits a formal upright layout without covering its center.

observations: Four black and gold fan-shaped ornaments anchor a tall rectangular frame.
Fine straight gold lines connect the decorative corners.

copy.title: Blue Engraved Oval with Medallion
copy.alt: Fine blue looping lines form an oval border with a small empty medallion below.
copy.description: Overlapping curves create a woven engraved appearance around the broad opening. A scalloped circular badge interrupts the lower edge.

observations: Dense blue loops form a horizontal oval around an empty center.
A small scalloped round medallion overlaps the bottom of the oval.

copy.title: Black Botanical Divider
copy.alt: Black stems, grasses and seed heads rise from a straight horizontal baseline.
copy.description: Long narrow leaves alternate with round and branching flower heads. Their different heights create a lively silhouette above the fine lower rule.

observations: Black botanical stems rise from a thin straight baseline.
Round seed heads, fine grasses and broad branching heads vary in height.

copy.title: Ivory Lace Circle
copy.alt: Ivory circular lace border with scalloped petal loops and pierced details.
copy.description: Small dotted lines follow the inner ring. Repeated open loops form a delicate edge around the clear circular center.

observations: Ivory looped petals form the outside of a circular lace-like border.
Fine dots and tiny pierced openings follow the inner rim.

copy.title: Golden Leaf Scroll Corner
copy.alt: Ornate golden corner with curling leaves, tapered tips and a small central rosette.
copy.description: The two arms sweep outward at a right angle. Dark recesses and bright ridges give the leafy ornament a raised metallic appearance.

observations: Golden curled leaves extend along two arms of an L-shaped ornament.
A small rosette joins the arms above a long tapered lower tip.

copy.title: Rope Frame with Blue Anchor
copy.alt: Cream rope forms a rectangular frame with knotted corners and a hanging blue anchor.
copy.description: Twisted strands run along each side of the opening. The small anchor hangs from a loop at the middle of the lower rope.

observations: Thick cream rope and rounded knots form an open rectangle.
A blue anchor hangs from the center of the bottom edge.

copy.title: Stitched Denim U Border
copy.alt: Indigo denim seam forms a U-shaped border with amber stitching and copper-colored rivets.
copy.description: Two parallel stitch rows follow the curved lower corners. A small folded fabric tab protrudes from one side of the open frame.

observations: A dark denim U-shaped strip carries two rows of amber stitching.
Small copper-colored rivets and a side fabric tab finish the border.

copy.title: Folk Floral Heart Border
copy.alt: Red and navy flowers with mustard leaves form an open heart border.
copy.description: The floral branches meet at a small pointed cluster below. Tiny diamonds and curled leaves balance the upper lobes.

observations: Small red and navy flowers follow a heart-shaped outline.
Mustard leaves and diamond-shaped details connect the floral branches.

copy.title: Paper Crane Arch
copy.alt: Six folded-paper cranes follow a fine curved line to form an open arch.
copy.description: Teal, rust and ivory birds alternate in size and wing position. Their angular folds create a light decorative arc.

observations: Six paper cranes in teal, rust and ivory sit along a curved line.
Different wing angles and bird sizes give the arch an uneven silhouette.

copy.title: Curled Paper Teardrop Border
copy.alt: Burgundy, cream and copper paper curls form a teardrop-shaped open border.
copy.description: Tight spirals alternate with elongated loops along the sides. A pointed folded loop closes the top while rounded curls gather below.

observations: Curled burgundy, cream and copper strips form a teardrop outline.
Small spirals alternate with long open loops around the shape.

copy.title: Copper Hexagon with Succulents and Crystal
copy.alt: Thin copper hexagon frame holds succulents at one corner and a hanging crystal at another.
copy.description: Small green rosettes and trailing round leaves cluster at the lower left. A clear pointed pendant hangs inside the upper-right edge.

observations: Slim copper rods form a six-sided open frame.
A succulent cluster and a small suspended crystal decorate opposing corners.

copy.title: Pearl and Blue Gem Oval
copy.alt: Pearl-like beads and small blue stones form an oval with a blue teardrop pendant below.
copy.description: Silver-colored settings separate the alternating beads. The larger drop hangs beneath a small jeweled connector at the base.

observations: Pale round beads alternate with small dark blue stones around an oval.
A larger blue teardrop pendant hangs from the lower center.

copy.title: Golden Scroll Frame with Blank Shield
copy.alt: Slim golden rectangular frame has curled corners and a small empty shield below.
copy.description: The upper corners curl inward while leaf-like lower ornaments sweep toward the shield. Thin straight rules leave a broad clear opening.

observations: Golden curled ornaments decorate a rectangular frame with shaped corners.
A small blank shield overlaps the lower center.

copy.title: Silver Scroll Cartouche
copy.alt: Silver ornamental border has a shell crest, curled sides and sweeping lower tails.
copy.description: Bright ridges and dark grooves emphasize the raised scroll shapes. The opening narrows toward the elaborate split base.

observations: A silver shell-like crest sits above an irregular open frame.
Curled side ornaments finish in two sweeping lower tails.

copy.title: Bamboo Frame with Leaf Sprays
copy.alt: Four bamboo stems form a square frame with green leaf sprays in opposite corners.
copy.description: Visible joints break up the pale tan stems. The leaves extend both inward and outward at the upper left and lower right.

observations: Four pale bamboo stems with visible joints form a square.
Pointed green leaves decorate the upper-left and lower-right corners.

copy.title: Terracotta Mosaic Arch Border
copy.alt: Open rounded arch border made of orange mosaic tiles with blue geometric insets.
copy.description: Pale grout lines divide the small warm-colored tiles. Blue diamonds and tiny squares interrupt the pattern around the tall opening.

observations: Orange mosaic tiles form a tall rounded arch with a flat lower edge.
Small blue geometric insets and pale grout lines punctuate the border.

copy.title: Mid-Century Ring and Starburst Oval
copy.alt: Thin teal and gold rings with small starbursts form a horizontal oval border.
copy.description: Larger circles occupy the sides while smaller linked rings stretch across the top and bottom. Tapered black spokes add contrast among the gold accents.

observations: Teal and gold rings join into a broad horizontal oval.
Small gold starbursts and dark tapered spokes sit between the rings.

copy.title: Double-Line Speech Balloon
copy.alt: Black double-line oval speech balloon with a pointed lower-left tail.
copy.description: The two slightly uneven contours follow the oval and its small tail. The empty opening leaves space for a short message.

observations: Two uneven black lines outline an oval speech balloon.
A pointed tail projects from the lower-left edge.

copy.title: Perforated Stamp Frame with Fern
copy.alt: Tall cream stamp-shaped border with perforated edges, a green inner rule and a tiny fern.
copy.description: Small regular notches follow the outer rectangle. A paired fern detail sits just inside the top edge above the empty center.

observations: A cream rectangular border has small postage-like perforations.
A thin green inner line and tiny fern decorate the upper center.

copy.title: Burgundy Folded Ribbon Divider
copy.alt: Long burgundy ribbon has stitched cream edges, layered ends and small brass-colored fasteners.
copy.description: The broad center remains blank between the folded side loops. Pointed swallowtail ends extend from both sides.

observations: A burgundy ribbon strip has cream edge stitching and layered folds.
Small metallic fasteners sit near its pointed tail ends.

copy.title: Cream Flower Crescent
copy.alt: Large cream flowers and dark green leaves follow a sweeping crescent branch.
copy.description: Smaller buds extend toward the two tips. The broad blossoms cluster along the lower left while glossy leaves fill the gaps.

observations: Cream blossoms and unopened buds follow a curved brown branch.
Glossy dark green leaves frame the open side of the crescent.

copy.title: Fern and Seed-Head Vertical Border
copy.alt: Fine fern fronds and small brown seed heads follow a narrow upright stem.
copy.description: The sprigs alternate from side to side with uneven spacing. Delicate leaflets create a light vertical accent rather than a filled panel.

observations: Several narrow fern fronds grow along a fine vertical stem.
Small brown seed-head shapes appear between the green sprigs.

copy.title: Grapevine Window Border
copy.alt: A rectangular grapevine frame with green leaves and two purple grape clusters.
copy.description: Twisting brown vines and curled tendrils connect the corners. The grape clusters sit diagonally opposite one another, leaving an open center.

observations: A rectangular frame of twisting brown vines carries lobed green grape leaves and fine curling tendrils.
Purple grape clusters sit in the upper left and lower right; the broad center is transparent.

copy.title: Purple and White Orchid Cascade
copy.alt: Purple and white orchid flowers cascade down a slender stem with pointed green leaves.
copy.description: Small unopened buds extend above and below the blossoms. The loose vertical arrangement keeps each flower's shape distinct.

observations: Purple and white orchids grow along a curving upright stem.
Pointed leaves and unopened buds extend between the flowers.

copy.title: Seashell and Blue Pendant Garland
copy.alt: Cream shells, sand dollars, blue pendants and a pink conch hang from a curved cord.
copy.description: The larger pink shell drops beneath the middle of the line. Different shell shapes alternate along the gently sagging natural-colored cord.

observations: Different cream shells and round sand dollars hang from a curved cord.
A large pink shell and small blue pendants add color near the center.

copy.title: Coral and Seahorse Circle
copy.alt: Peach coral and pale blue sea fans form a circular border with a small seahorse.
copy.description: The seahorse curls beside the lower-right arc. Fine branching fans alternate with thicker coral shapes around the clear center.

observations: Peach branching coral alternates with pale blue sea fans around a circle.
A small orange seahorse rests along the lower-right side.

copy.title: Butterfly Vine Corner
copy.alt: Three different butterflies perch around a curved green vine corner.
copy.description: Spotted orange, pale blue and cream wings appear at different angles. Small leaves follow the vine's long lower curl.

observations: Orange, blue and cream butterflies sit around an L-shaped leafy vine.
The vine has a long curling lower stem and small pointed leaves.

copy.title: Black Feather Crescent
copy.alt: Layered black-and-white feathers curve into an open crescent with a tied lower tip.
copy.description: Fine lines trace the feather barbs along the sweeping outer edge. Dark quills overlap where the feathers gather below.

observations: Long black-and-white feathers overlap along a crescent shape.
Fine barb lines and a small tied cord mark the lower end.

copy.title: Blue Gingham Bow Divider
copy.alt: Blue-and-white checked ribbon stretches from a large bow with two small folded loops.
copy.description: The left bow has long pointed tails beneath its gathered center. The checked pattern follows the ribbon's small folds along the horizontal strip.

observations: A large blue-and-white gingham bow anchors the left side of a ribbon.
Two small folded loops interrupt the long checked strip.

copy.title: Purple Knitted Circle with Needles
copy.alt: Thick purple knitted ring sits above crossed wooden needles and a small yarn ball.
copy.description: Raised cable-like stitches follow the circle. A loose yarn end curls beside the ball beneath the needle crossing.

observations: A thick plum-colored knitted cable forms an open circle.
Two wooden needles cross above a small purple yarn ball and loose strand.

copy.title: Pencil and Ruler Classroom Corner
copy.alt: Yellow pencil, wooden rulers, pink eraser and curled shavings form a classroom corner.
copy.description: The upright pencil stands beside a slanted ruler, with another ruler extending across the base. The eraser and shavings gather at their meeting point.

observations: A yellow pencil and two wooden rulers form a right-angled stationery arrangement.
A pink eraser and curled pencil shavings cluster near the lower corner.

copy.title: Colorful Crayon Zigzag Frame
copy.alt: A red, blue, green and yellow zigzag crayon frame with two crayons below.
copy.description: Short colored strokes fill the gaps between the zigzags. A red crayon and a blue crayon meet near the lower center of the open frame.

observations: Red, blue, green and yellow crayon-like zigzags and short marks form a narrow rectangular border.
A red and a blue crayon meet near the lower center; the inner center is transparent.

copy.title: ABC Blocks and Toy Train Divider
copy.alt: Colorful A, B and C blocks line up with a small toy engine and a red star.
copy.description: The blocks tilt at different angles along the low horizontal arrangement. Round toy wheels and a red knob add small raised shapes between the letters.

observations: Three colored toy blocks display the letters A, B and C.
A small toy engine and red star sit between the letter blocks.

copy.title: Geometry Tools Triangle
copy.alt: Blue set square, wooden rulers and a silver compass form a triangular arrangement.
copy.description: The compass hinge closes the top point while the rulers follow the lower and right sides. The blue set square creates a smaller open triangle inside.

observations: A silver drawing compass sits above two wooden rulers in a triangular shape.
A blue set square fills the left corner of the arrangement.

copy.title: Paintbrush and Watercolor Side Border
copy.alt: Three paintbrushes, colored swatches and a small watercolor box form a narrow side border.
copy.description: The brush tips rise above blue, yellow and green paint marks. A leafy sprig and open paint pans finish the lower end.

observations: Three paintbrushes rise beside small blue, yellow and green swatches.
A small open watercolor box and leafy sprig sit at the bottom.

copy.title: Blue and Green DNA Border
copy.alt: Stylized blue and green double helix forms a tall border with small molecular nodes.
copy.description: The two winding strands connect through short rungs. Small round nodes extend from the sides at different heights.

observations: Two blue and green strands twist around evenly spaced connecting rungs.
Small round molecular nodes project from both sides of the tall helix.

copy.title: Violin, Piano Keys and Treble Clef
copy.alt: Orange violin, short piano keyboard and black treble clef line up in a horizontal arrangement.
copy.description: Five black keys in two groups sit above eight white keys. The violin's warm wood contrasts with the neutral keyboard and curved music symbol.

observations: An orange violin and a black treble clef flank a short straight keyboard.
The keyboard has eight white keys and five black keys arranged as a group of two and a group of three.

copy.title: Robot Circuit Corner
copy.alt: Small blue robot peeks over an L-shaped border of navy circuit traces and gold contacts.
copy.description: Parallel traces turn around the lower-left corner and end in round gold pads. The robot's bright eyes and single antenna give the small ornament a friendly focus.

observations: Navy circuit traces with gold contact pads form a compact L-shaped border.
A small blue robot with bright eyes and an antenna peeks over the corner.

copy.title: Open Books and Bookmark Crescent
copy.alt: Three open books, a small gold-colored lamp and a red ribbon form a curved side border.
copy.description: Blank cream pages face the open center at different angles. The ribbon curls away below the lowest book.

observations: Three open books with cream pages follow a left-hand curve.
A small gold-colored lamp and curling red bookmark ribbon sit among the books.

copy.title: Fox and Squirrel Branch Frame
copy.alt: Thin twisting branches frame a seated fox and a squirrel on the opposite upper corner.
copy.description: Small green leaves break up the woody border. The two animals face toward the open center from different heights.

observations: An orange fox sits at the lower-left corner of a branch frame.
A red squirrel balances on the upper-right branch among small leaves.

copy.title: Soccer Ball and Goal Net Corner
copy.alt: Black-and-white soccer ball rests in grass beside a diagonal section of white goal net.
copy.description: The tied net lines rise toward the upper right. Several pointed grass blades surround the lower part of the ball.

observations: A black-and-white soccer ball sits among green grass blades.
A white tied goal net rises diagonally behind the ball.

copy.title: Basketball and Hoop Oval
copy.alt: Thin orange oval lines connect an orange basketball and a small hoop with a white net.
copy.description: The ball overlaps the left edge while the hoop sits above the right curve. The wide central opening remains clear.

observations: An orange basketball overlaps a thin oval border on the left.
A small basketball hoop and white net sit at the upper right.

copy.title: Graduation Laurel Border
copy.alt: Dark green laurel branches surround a black graduation cap, diploma and navy bow.
copy.description: The two leafy branches rise around a broad opening. A gold tassel hangs from the cap above the rolled cream diploma.

observations: Two dark green laurel branches form an open circular border.
A black mortarboard, cream diploma and navy bow meet at the bottom.

copy.title: Interlocked Gold Rings Divider
copy.alt: Two interlocked gold rings sit between leafy sprigs and ivory ribbon curls.
copy.description: The slim branches extend outward from the ring pair. Small pale ribbon folds soften the ends of the compact wedding ornament.

observations: Two gold rings overlap at the middle of a horizontal divider.
Olive-colored leafy sprigs and ivory ribbon curls extend to both sides.

copy.title: Blue Dreidel and Gold Coin Corner
copy.alt: Blue dreidel, pouch of gold coins and curling navy ribbon form a festive corner.
copy.description: Loose coins spill beside the small blue pouch. Fine gold edges follow the ribbon as it twists above and across the still life.

observations: An unlettered blue dreidel stands beside a blue pouch spilling gold coins.
A navy ribbon with gold trim curls upward and toward the right.

copy.title: Holly and Bell Arch
copy.alt: Sparse holly leaves and red berries form an arch topped with two brass-colored bells and a red bow.
copy.description: The bells hang beneath the large bow at the top. Small leaf clusters and berries follow the two open sides.

observations: Holly leaves and red berries follow an open arch.
Two gold-colored bells hang beneath a large red bow at the top.

copy.title: Basket between Tall Cornstalks
copy.alt: Two tall dry cornstalks rise beside a small woven basket.
copy.description: Long curled leaves wrap around the golden stalks. Their outward lean creates a narrow U-shaped harvest border above the basket.

observations: Two tall golden cornstalks stand on opposite sides of a woven basket.
Dry curling leaves and husked ears follow the stalks upward.

copy.title: Spiderweb Scroll Corner
copy.alt: Black-and-white spiderweb fills an ornamental corner above a small hanging spider.
copy.description: Curved flourishes extend from the web's two outer arms. The little spider hangs near the inner lower curl.

observations: A radial black spiderweb stretches between two curling corner lines.
A small eight-legged cartoon spider hangs below the web.

copy.title: Birthday Pennant Garland
copy.alt: Colored patterned pennants hang between two paper honeycomb decorations.
copy.description: Stripes, dots and solid colors alternate along the gently sagging cord. Yellow and blue folded-paper ornaments finish the two ends.

observations: Bright triangular flags hang from a curved cord with different patterns.
Yellow and blue paper honeycomb decorations sit at the garland's ends.

copy.title: Black Geometric Maze Frame
copy.alt: Bold black meandering lines form a square frame with enlarged corner turns.
copy.description: A narrow double rule follows the inner opening. Repeated right-angle paths create a structured border around the clear center.

observations: Black right-angle meander lines form a square ornamental frame.
Larger corner turns and a fine double inner rule define the opening.

copy.title: Family Walking Through a Zoo Entrance
copy.alt: A family walks beneath a green ZOO arch decorated with giraffe and elephant silhouettes.
copy.description: Leaf-topped pillars frame the open green gates. Giraffes, an elephant and broad trees appear beyond the visitors.

observations: A tall jade-and-ochre entrance arch has the clearly visible word ZOO and animal-shaped pillar decorations.
Several small visitors walk through the gates, with a giraffe and elephant in separate landscape areas behind.

copy.title: Family Reading a Zoo Map
copy.alt: A woman and two children hold an unfolded zoo map with animal icons and winding paths.
copy.description: The boy grips one side while the girl points toward the illustrated routes. A penguin, giraffe and butterfly distinguish parts of the map.

observations: The source includes three people, rather than only the folded-paper object in the planning prompt.
The large green map has dotted paths and distinct penguin, giraffe and butterfly pictograms; the woman wears a plum top and backpack.

copy.title: Child Collecting a Zoo Ticket
copy.alt: A child in yellow overalls reaches toward a ticket at a wooden zoo admission booth beside a woman.
copy.description: The small booth has a green roof and an elephant plaque above its open window. The attendant leans forward for the exchange.

observations: The child stands with one arm extended to the attendant at the ticket window; a woman in purple waits beside them.
The wood-sided kiosk has an elephant silhouette above the window and a potted plant at the lower right.

copy.title: Father and Toddler at the Elephant Habitat
copy.alt: A father pushes a toddler in a stroller beside a wooden zoo railing overlooking an elephant.
copy.description: The elephant stands near rocks and a broad green tree beyond the barrier. The stroller and its seated child remain on the visitor path.

observations: An adult in an orange shirt holds the stroller handle, with a toddler seated inside.
A gray tusked elephant stands behind a separated visitor rail amid rocks and trees.

copy.title: Teacher Leading Children Through the Zoo
copy.alt: A teacher points toward a giraffe as four children walk beneath a wooden ZOO gateway.
copy.description: The children wear different bright jackets and carry backpacks. Animal-picture activity cards add a school-trip detail to the group.

observations: The adult with a long braid wears a teal jacket and points toward the giraffe at the right.
Four children have different hair, skin tones and coat colors; several carry small animal cards.

copy.title: Watching Wetland Birds from a Zoo Boardwalk
copy.alt: A silver-haired wheelchair user and a child look at two long-legged birds across a wetland viewing rail.
copy.description: Reeds rise behind the mesh-sided wooden deck. The child leans forward and points while the adult rests a hand near the wheelchair wheel.

observations: A silver-haired adult in purple is seated in a manual wheelchair beside a curly-haired child.
Two gray, red-marked long-legged birds stand among the reeds beyond the wooden visitor railing.

copy.title: Green Lion Zoo Tram
copy.alt: A green zoo tram has a friendly lion-faced engine and open passenger carriages.
copy.description: Gold trim outlines the rounded canopy and small wheels. Seated visitors look out from the two linked cars behind the decorative engine.

observations: The engine front has a large sculpted cartoon lion face, with a green funnel above and dark cowcatcher below.
Two open green carriages carry visitors and connect behind the engine; wheels and roofs are fully visible.

copy.title: Zoo Ticket and Elephant Admission Stamp
copy.alt: A hand holds an orange ZOO ticket beside a small blue elephant stamp on the wrist.
copy.description: A giraffe and elephant decorate the ticket. Behind the close-up hand, visitors walk through a wooden entrance beside an elephant viewing area.

observations: An orange ticket with ZOO lettering and two animal silhouettes is pinched by the hand.
The blue elephant admission mark is visible on the wrist; an entrance arch and elephant habitat form a smaller scene behind.

copy.title: Girl Wearing a Zoo Wristband
copy.alt: A smiling girl fastens a wristband beside blue and orange admission bands and a giraffe visitor pass.
copy.description: The loose bands curl across the foreground. A giraffe and small habitat sign appear beyond the railing behind her.

observations: The girl has a high dark ponytail, purple shirt and backpack while holding her opposite wrist.
Two large curled paper bands and a giraffe pass occupy the foreground, with a giraffe habitat behind.

copy.title: Zoo Animal Direction Signpost
copy.alt: Wooden arrow signs show penguin, giraffe and butterfly illustrations.
copy.description: A penguin arrow points left; the giraffe and butterfly arrows point right. Leafy shoots grow around the base of the wooden post.

observations: Three wooden arrows show a penguin, a giraffe and an orange butterfly on a central wooden pole.
The penguin arrow points left and the other two point right; green leaves cluster at the bottom.

copy.title: Children at the Hippo Window
copy.alt: Two children crouch beside a rounded underwater window where a hippopotamus swims past.
copy.description: Blue water fills the stone-edged opening. The children face one another across the window, wearing purple and green tops with small backpacks.

observations: The hippo is shown underwater behind a rounded gray stone viewing window, with its snout turned toward the right.
Two crouching children occupy opposite sides, one with pigtails and a purple backpack and one with a blue backpack.

copy.title: Photographing a Giraffe at the Zoo
copy.alt: A short-haired visitor raises a camera toward a giraffe beyond a wooden viewing rail.
copy.description: A pale sunhat hangs from the visitor backpack. The giraffe leans its long neck into view above the mesh-sided barrier.

observations: The photographer has short auburn hair, a green top, dark shorts and a pale hat hanging from a backpack.
The giraffe has patterned fur and visible ossicones; its long neck rises behind a wooden mesh barrier.

copy.title: Grandfather and Girl Watching a Panda
copy.alt: A gray-haired grandfather and a girl sit on a bench facing a panda resting on a wooden platform.
copy.description: The panda rests its front paws along the platform edge. Rocks, bamboo and supporting logs surround the small viewing scene.

observations: The two visitors sit side by side with their backs partly facing the viewer; the grandfather wears a mustard padded vest.
The giant panda rests on a log-framed elevated platform behind a distinct visitor railing.

copy.title: Toddler Pointing at Penguins
copy.alt: A toddler with a red backpack points toward penguins through a tall blue zoo window while holding an adult hand.
copy.description: The child rises onto one foot in front of the stone window base. The accompanying adult is shown from the shoulders down.

observations: The child wears an orange top and red backpack, raising one hand to the penguin window and holding the adult with the other.
Two prominent penguins stand beyond the glass; the companion adult is intentionally shown without the head.

copy.title: Visitor Sketching a Zebra
copy.alt: A visitor with round glasses sketches in a notebook while seated opposite a zebra enclosure.
copy.description: The burgundy sweater and folding stool stand out against the pale habitat wall. The zebra faces the visitor from beyond a wood-and-wire fence.

observations: A curly-haired visitor in a burgundy sweater and tan trousers sits on a black folding stool with a pencil and notebook.
One zebra stands behind the horizontal wooden rail and mesh enclosure, with rocks and trees farther behind.

copy.title: Friends Watching an Orangutan
copy.alt: Two friends lean near a zoo viewing rail while an orangutan hangs from overhead ropes.
copy.description: The orange-haired animal grips two different supports. The visitors wear a lavender headscarf with a denim jacket and a green striped shirt.

observations: One visitor wears a lavender headscarf and pale denim jacket; the other wears a green striped tee and backpack.
The orangutan hangs behind the barrier between two overhead supports, one rope above and one to its right.

copy.title: Family Walking Beside Flamingos
copy.alt: A family follows a curved wooden boardwalk beside a pool of pink flamingos.
copy.description: A red-capped child walks between two adults. Reeds and rocks border the shallow blue pool beyond the railing.

observations: A mother with a short dark bob wears a coral top, while the father wears teal and carries a backpack; a child in a red cap walks between them.
Several pink flamingos stand in pale blue water, some with lowered heads, beyond the curved mesh-sided boardwalk.

copy.title: Visitor Looking into an Iguana Terrarium
copy.alt: A visitor in a navy hoodie leans toward a glass terrarium containing a green iguana.
copy.description: The iguana lies on a diagonal branch among broad leaves. A small lizard pictogram marks the dark display base.

observations: The visitor has a blue-gray backpack, jeans and bright yellow sneakers while leaning toward the glass.
The green iguana rests along a branch inside a tall lit terrarium with foliage and a lizard icon plaque.

copy.title: Girl in the Butterfly House
copy.alt: A girl in a coral pinafore watches butterflies beneath the curved frame of a glass butterfly house.
copy.description: Orange and blue butterflies hover near the domed green structure. Flowering plants gather along both sides of the open doorway.

observations: A dark-bobbed girl stands with her hands down inside the green-framed domed structure.
Two prominent butterflies, orange above and blue at the right, appear beside flowering pink and orange plants.

copy.title: Child at a Beetle Viewing Window
copy.alt: A curly-haired child in a green raincoat looks through a circular window at a horned beetle.
copy.description: The round metal frame sits in a wooden panel. Leaves and a rough branch surround the large beetle inside the display.

observations: The child bends forward with one hand near the round viewing frame, wearing yellow rain boots and a green coat.
A large dark horned beetle is visible against wood and foliage inside the circular glass display.

copy.title: Watching a Lion Through Public Binoculars
copy.alt: A visitor in an orange jacket uses mounted binoculars to view a lion resting on rocks.
copy.description: The public viewing rail separates the visitor from the habitat. A long mane and raised rocky ledge distinguish the reclining lion.

observations: The visitor has a braided high bun, orange hooded jacket and dark backpack, with both hands holding mounted binoculars.
A male lion with a brown mane rests on a rock platform beyond the wood rail and moat-like lower habitat.

copy.title: Older Visitors at the Rhino Window
copy.alt: An older couple stands beside a bench looking at a rhinoceros beyond a zoo viewing wall.
copy.description: The woman points toward the gray animal while her companion leans closer. Rocks, water and a broad green tree frame the habitat.

observations: The gray-haired man wears a blue shirt and tan trousers; the gray-haired woman in burgundy raises a pointing hand.
A gray rhinoceros stands beside pale blue water behind a low visitor wall and a wooden bench.

copy.title: Family Visiting the Bat House
copy.alt: A family watches hanging bats through a purple-lit zoo viewing window.
copy.description: The rounded dark arch encloses a small nighttime habitat. The child points upward while the two adults stand close behind.

observations: Three visitors stand within a dark rounded entrance, one child in front wearing a small pink backpack.
Several bats hang head down beyond the large viewing panel, with purple and blue light confined to the nocturnal display.

copy.title: Peacock Crossing the Zoo Path
copy.alt: A blue-and-green peacock walks across a zoo path while a woman and child pause behind it.
copy.description: Its long lowered tail trails across the foreground. An animal information panel and curved mesh barrier mark the visitor route.

observations: The peacock has a blue neck, crest and long patterned tail with eyespots; its tail is lowered rather than fanned.
A woman with a bun and purple top stands beside a child in turquoise; they remain behind the foreground bird.

copy.title: Visitors Watching a Red Panda in a Tree
copy.alt: Two visitors lean beside a wooden rail and look up at a red panda resting on a branch.
copy.description: The reddish animal curls its thick striped tail down the tree. Leaves and rounded rocks create a compact habitat around the viewing area.

observations: A dark-skinned visitor in a lilac shirt stands beside a person with a long brown braid and pale sweater.
A reddish panda with pale face markings lies high on a branch, its rust-and-cream striped tail draping down.

copy.title: Child Inside a Meerkat Viewing Dome
copy.alt: A child in a yellow cap looks through a clear observation dome at three meerkats.
copy.description: One meerkat stands upright near the dome while the others sit and walk among the rocks. The sealed dome keeps the child separate from the animals.

observations: The child is inside a transparent hemispherical viewing bubble with hands raised against the glass.
Three meerkats occupy different positions outside: upright at the right, seated near the middle and walking in front.

copy.title: Friends at the Sea Lion Window
copy.alt: A wheelchair user and a standing friend watch a sea lion swim behind a broad underwater window.
copy.description: The seated visitor points toward the animal. Blue water and faint underwater rocks remain inside the rounded glass opening.

observations: A seated visitor with short coiled hair and a purple top points toward the water; a standing companion wears a green hoodie and tan backpack.
A gray-brown sea lion swims behind the window with its small external ear and front flippers visible.

copy.title: Visitors Crossing an Aviary Bridge
copy.alt: Two visitors cross a wooden rope bridge beneath two colorful parrots.
copy.description: The red and blue parrots perch on a leafy branch above the walkway. One visitor wears a yellow jacket while the other carries a backpack over a blue top.

observations: A woman in a yellow jacket and an adult in a blue top stand on a wooden rope bridge.
A red-and-yellow parrot and a blue-and-yellow parrot perch on a branch among broad green leaves.

copy.title: Watching a Mother and Joey at the Zoo
copy.alt: A woman and child watch a long-tailed marsupial with a joey in its pouch from a visitor path.
copy.description: The mother animal sits upright beside a small information panel. Low rope posts separate its grassy space from the visitors.

observations: A woman in a blue sunhat bends beside a girl in a purple dress, both standing on the visitor side of low rope posts.
The brown animal has long upright ears, large hind feet, a heavy tail and a small joey visible in its pouch.

copy.title: Children Following Zoo Footprints
copy.alt: Three children compare a zoo activity card with large animal footprint shapes along a path.
copy.description: One child crouches to touch a print while another holds the card. An elephant habitat and tall giraffes appear beyond the fence.

observations: The three children have different hair, skin tones and clothes, including a purple jacket, green top and pale sunhat.
Four large footprint symbols run along the path, and the standing child holds a small card with animal pictures and checkboxes.

copy.title: Father Pulling a Child in a Zoo Wagon
copy.alt: A father pulls a red wagon carrying a small child with a stuffed animal.
copy.description: The child sits inside the low wagon wearing a red top. A tiny giraffe tag hangs from the side as the father walks ahead holding the long handle.

observations: The adult has a bald head, short beard, pale blue polo and tan shorts; his entire figure is now visible.
The red four-wheel wagon carries a child with two small hair buns and a plush toy; a giraffe tag hangs from its side.

copy.title: Family Picnic at the Zoo
copy.alt: Four family members share lunch at a wooden picnic table with a giraffe sign.
copy.description: The gray-haired grandmother wears a blue floral blouse. Open lunchboxes, bread and small fruit pieces sit between the adults and children.

observations: The group includes a gray-curled grandmother, short-haired adult and two children in red and purple tops.
The entire brown picnic table and benches are visible, with a small giraffe panel attached to the table front.

copy.title: Friends Having Lunch at the Zoo
copy.alt: Two friends sit beneath a giraffe-topped parasol with a visitor map and drinks.
copy.description: An adult in a teal shirt holds a drink while the other studies the map. Giraffes and a viewing rail establish the cafe setting.

observations: Two casually dressed visitors sit at a small table beneath a green-and-cream parasol.
A decorative giraffe head tops the parasol; a real giraffe and zoo habitat are visible behind the seats.

copy.title: Choosing a Plush Animal at the Zoo
copy.alt: A child points toward stuffed animals at a wooden zoo kiosk beside an older woman with glasses.
copy.description: Pandas, giraffes and elephants fill the shelves beneath a green awning. The companion has a short silver bob, terracotta jumpsuit and pale shoulder bag.

observations: The companion is now an older gray-bobbed woman with round glasses and terracotta clothing, clearly different from the previous purple-hoodie character.
The child in lime reaches toward the shelf containing gray elephants, with plush giraffes above and pandas along the side.

copy.title: Elephant and Giraffe Photo Board
copy.alt: Two children put their faces through openings in an elephant-and-giraffe photo board.
copy.description: The animal bodies are printed on a freestanding wooden display. The children hold the side edges as they smile through the face holes.

observations: The left photo opening is inside a gray elephant face and the right inside a tall giraffe figure.
Two different children smile through oval face holes, with hands visible along the board edges and wooden supports below.

copy.title: Washing Hands After the Petting Area
copy.alt: A braided girl washes her hands in an outdoor sink beneath a goat pictogram.
copy.description: Water and small bubbles gather around her hands. The freestanding basin, soap dispenser and exposed support pipes remain clearly visible.

observations: The girl has one long dark braid, a red striped shirt, dark jeans and purple sneakers; her whole body is inside the source canvas.
The gray basin is supported by exposed pipes beside a brown post with a goat icon and blue soap dispenser.

copy.title: Child and Adult in the Petting Area
copy.alt: A child in orange overalls gently pets a brown-and-white goat beside an adult.
copy.description: The child wears a green bucket hat and striped shirt. A dark denim jacket and pale trousers distinguish the adult standing beside the low wooden fence.

observations: The child has a ginger bob under a green bucket hat and rests one hand near the goat shoulder.
The adult now has dark skin, a shaved head, short beard and navy denim jacket; the goat has a white face stripe and two visible horns.

copy.title: Rainy Visit to the Zoo
copy.alt: An adult and child in blue and yellow raincoats share a clear umbrella outside the zoo.
copy.description: Their bright ponchos reflect in a small puddle. A wooden ZOO arch and animal-picture signpost stand behind them.

observations: The adult wears a blue hooded poncho while the child wears a yellow hooded poncho and rain boots.
They share a transparent umbrella with visible ribs; a zoo entrance and pictogram signpost appear behind.

copy.title: Refilling a Bottle at the Zoo
copy.alt: A red-haired visitor fills a bottle at a water station beside a giraffe enclosure.
copy.description: The tall green dispenser carries a giraffe pictogram. The visitor wears a green shirt, gray shorts and a black backpack.

observations: A visitor with a long auburn ponytail holds a bottle below the spout of a tall green water refill post.
A giraffe pictogram marks the post and a tall giraffe stands behind a nearby habitat rail.

copy.title: Zoo Birthday Picnic
copy.alt: Three children wearing animal-themed party hats sit around a birthday cake at a zoo picnic table.
copy.description: A lion crown, elephant-ear hat and striped animal headband give each child a different look. An elephant and giraffe appear beyond the fence.

observations: Three children with different hair and skin tones sit at a brown picnic table, wearing different animal-style paper crowns.
A round animal-decorated cake and two bowls sit on the table; an elephant and giraffe are visible behind the fence.

copy.title: Lantern Tour Beside an Owl Enclosure
copy.alt: A guide carrying a lantern leads a woman and child beside an owl enclosure in black-and-white line art.
copy.description: The owl perches on a branch behind mesh. Boots, backpacks and the hanging lantern distinguish the three visitors along the path.

observations: Three walking people appear beside a tall mesh enclosure, with a lantern hanging from the front guide hand.
An owl perches on a branch inside the enclosure; the entire image is clean monochrome line art with open coloring regions.

copy.title: Children at a Giraffe Playground Slide
copy.alt: Children climb and wait beside a giraffe-shaped playground slide in black-and-white line art.
copy.description: A long curved chute descends from the tall giraffe structure. Steps and handrails lead to the small platform above.

observations: The playground has a giraffe head above the slide and stairs with railings on the opposite side.
A child sits near the top and another stands at the bottom; bushes and a visitor rail provide a small zoo setting.

copy.title: School Trip Arriving at the Zoo
copy.alt: A teacher and children step from a school bus beside a ZOO ARRIVAL sign in black-and-white line art.
copy.description: The open bus doorway fills one side of the scene. An elephant pictogram and distant habitat fence mark the arrival point.

observations: The image shows the bus doorway, one large wheel and three people stepping onto a path; the rest of the bus is outside the vignette.
The tall sign visibly reads ZOO ARRIVAL with an elephant pictogram, and a distant elephant stands behind the fence.

copy.title: Returning a Lost Plush Penguin
copy.alt: A zoo attendant hands a plush penguin to a child across a guest-services counter in black-and-white line art.
copy.description: A mitten-and-toy pictogram marks the counter. The child reaches up with both hands while the attendant leans forward.

observations: The attendant wears a collared shirt and name badge and holds a small stuffed penguin toward the child.
A counter pictogram shows a mitten and teddy bear; giraffes and two visitors appear beyond the service area.

copy.title: Visitors at a Zoo Map Kiosk
copy.alt: Two visitors stand beside a freestanding animal-picture map kiosk in black-and-white line art.
copy.description: The taller visitor points toward a circular animal symbol. A younger companion holds a folded map while both look at the roofed display.

observations: The tall visitor has short tousled hair, shorts and a backpack; the smaller visitor wears two plaits and holds a paper map.
The complete roofed kiosk has a plinth base and three large animal pictograms connected by simple route lines, without surrounding scenery.

copy.title: Family Posing for a Zoo Photograph
copy.alt: A family of four poses on a curved animal-decorated bench before a tripod camera in black-and-white line art.
copy.description: The two children sit between the adults. Small animal silhouettes along the bench back reinforce the zoo setting.

observations: Four family members with different faces and hair sit or stand close together on a curved bench.
A small camera on a three-legged tripod is centered in front of the bench, whose back carries animal silhouette panels.

copy.title: Visitor Exploring an Elephant Relief Panel
copy.alt: A visitor with sunglasses and a white cane touches an elephant relief panel beside a child in black-and-white line art.
copy.description: The sloping panel stands at hand height near an elephant viewing area. The child watches the adult trace the raised animal shape.

observations: The adult wears dark sunglasses and holds a long cane while extending the other hand to a raised elephant silhouette.
A child with a ponytail and backpack stands to the left; an elephant is visible beyond the zoo railing.

copy.title: Zoo Activity Clipboard and Binoculars
copy.alt: An animal checklist clipboard, pencil and binoculars form a black-and-white outline still life.
copy.description: Elephant, penguin, giraffe and butterfly pictures sit beside four empty checkboxes. The tilted clipboard and binoculars remain separate, easy-to-see objects.

observations: The new source is an object-only composition with no child or hands, unlike the rejected version.
Four animal pictograms and empty checkboxes appear on the complete clipboard, with a large pencil to the left and binoculars to the right.

copy.title: Waving Goodbye at the Zoo Exit
copy.alt: A child carrying a souvenir bag waves beside an exit arch with a right-pointing arrow in black-and-white line art.
copy.description: Animal faces decorate the backpack and bag. A giraffe and elephant appear beyond the simple gate.

observations: The smiling curly-haired child wears shorts and a backpack and raises one hand toward the arch.
A small bag with a lion-face emblem sits at the child side; the arch has an arrow above the opening and a zoo habitat behind.

copy.title: Resting Beside the Tortoise Habitat
copy.alt: An older visitor and child sit on a bench beside two tortoises in black-and-white line art.
copy.description: The tortoises occupy a raised grassy area behind a low wall. The wide bench scene leaves generous open shapes for coloring.

observations: The older visitor in a brimmed cap sits beside a small child on a wood-slatted bench.
Two large tortoises stand beyond a low wall with grass tufts and a broad tree behind.
